Overview

Rzeszów is a city in Subcarpathian with a population of 196,208. A rapidly growing city in southeastern Poland, emerging as a major IT and aviation hub with a charming old town and a dynamic economy. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
